messages:
maria: FYI - AcmePay reporting sustained 429s around 11:12-11:22 UTC. Dedicated pool dp-nyc-1 didn't scale up fast enough, requests queued for minutes. Customer is escalated.

jessica: Sev2 from CS. They see spikes in latency and a bunch of 429s. Need timeline and repro ASAP.

ashok: Looking at autoscaler logs - saw repeated preflight failures and backoff. Snippet:```
2024-03-07T11:13:05Z autoscaler preflight check failed: timeout=30s, reason=preflight_probe_timeout
2024-03-07T11:14:05Z autoscaler backoff increment -> 2m
```

kevin: Kube events show pods stuck in Pending -> ContainerCreating for ~90s. Attach/volume wait + image pull. Example:```
Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling  90s  default-scheduler  0/10 nodes available: 10 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 2 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
  Normal   Pulling           70s  kubelet           Pulling image registry.redwood/models/gf-3-large:v2
```

maria: Repro steps I ran (on staging to reproduce):
1) run 120 concurrent requests to /v1/generate (model gf-3-large)
2) each request ~300 tokens, no caching/prefix KV
Command: `hey -n 1000 -c 120 -m POST https://staging.redwood/v1/generate -D payload.json`
Result: immediate queue growth and slow scale events.

ashok: Two likely contributors: (1) autoscaler preflight timeout too short for large model pulls, so it aborts and backs off; (2) rate-limited cloud API / nodepool autoscaler throttle (we have node create rate cap). Headroom calc also seems conservative because it uses average CPU instead of pending queue length.

kevin: Also suspicious noisy-neighbor signal: one tenant on dp-nyc-1 launched a large batched job and consumed >80% GPU mem, causing scheduler to prefer older nodes and delaying new pod placements. We saw GPU memory pressure metrics spike.

jessica: Can we do a temporary manual bump for AcmePay - either increase min_replicas or pin a reserved node so they stop seeing 429s?

sre-oncall: Manual override applied: scaled cluster acmepay-dedicated min_replicas 2 -> 5 at 11:16 UTC. New pod creation started immediately but warmup took longer than expected: image pull ~45s, model unpack ~90s, verif probe ~30s. Observed full readiness ~4m after scale request.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: warmup job started for gf-3-large on dp-nyc-1 (job id: warmup-1728345720-acmepay).

ashok: Hypothesis: nodepool autoscaler rate_limit = 1 node/min. When multiple customers ramp, preflight backoff + rate cap causes long queue. Options: increase rate_limit (burst mode), increase preflight timeout to 120s for large models, or add emergency fast-path to bypass backoff for high-priority customers. Also fix headroom calc to factor pending queue length.

kevin: Minimal repro script (staging):```
# step 1 - warmup model
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/v1/warmup -d '{"model":"gf-3-large"}'
# step 2 - load gen
hey -n 500 -c 150 -m POST https://staging.redwood/v1/generate -D payload.json
```
Run this while watching `kubectl get events -w` and `kubectl describe node` to see scheduling delays.

maria: Customer asking for RCA + ETA. Proposed mitigation plan: short-term: manual min_replicas bump + fallback to smaller model variant (gf-3-medium) for non-critical traffic. Mid-term: change autoscaler config (preflight timeout 30->120s, rate_limit burst) + change headroom calc. Long-term: pre-pull popular model images on pool nodes and implement per-tenant GPU quotas to reduce noisy neighbor risk.

jessica: I'll draft the response to AcmePay and offer 10% credit for the impacted window. @ashok can you validate whether the autoscaler config change will affect other regions?

ashok: Will validate. Plan to run a canary in staging: increase autoscaler burst to 3 nodes/min and preflight timeout to 120s for dp-nyc-1 staging. Monitor for 1h (watch node creation rates and cloud API 429s). If CI passes, roll to prod night window.

sre-oncall: Noted cloud provider API 429 spikes at 11:17:00 UTC which coincided with our node create attempts - saw response headers X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0. That likely contributed to failures.

kevin: Pushed a Grafana panel link for the cluster and autoscaler events: https://grafana.redwood/boards/dp-nyc-1?panel=autoscaler (shareable).

maria: Thanks everyone — keeping AcmePay updated. Will follow up after ashoks canary. :thumbsup:
